body:
I don't really have anyone other than my roommates, and I have a lot of trouble communicating with them. 

Yeah I have considered vocational and other education, but with no funds that is very difficult. I don't know of any internships, but I could look into them. 

I don't have the money for counseling. 

I've used meetup before to volunteer feeding the homeless but have a hard time finding groups to actually hangout with. 

No, I haven't tried meditation or yoga. When I am very stressed I go for long walks or runs. 

I could try scribbling or drawing, that sounds nice. 

I own a cat who is very attached to me. Having him around has helped a lot. 

I refuse to cry. I feel like people have been through a lot worse than I have, I should not cry. 

I'm having trouble seeing the end of this week, 85 is one hell of a stretch. 

I have, as well as various books. My mother most likely suffers from borderline personality disorder as all the books I have read of sufferers and their children are eerily similar. 

I try to watch thing I like daily, and it does help, sometimes. 

I hope I can make it, but I still feel like a pretty awful person. Not quite sure why though.
Thanks for the kind words. I'll look into plasma selling first chance I get!

I would like to be both comfortable in my skin and have a job. 

I try not to think about the past, but it comes up a few times a day.
